# Cyber Resilience in the Agentic AI Era


Nov 2, 2026


Share


As AI accelerates both opportunities and threats, the traditional cybersecurity playbook is undergoing a transformation.


Carnival Corporation’s Global Chief Information Security Officer, Margarita Rivera, recently joined fellow cybersecurity leaders at the Bloomberg Live panel, Cyber Resilience in the Agentic AI Era. She discussed how organizations must become faster and more agile while maintaining strong oversight, managing third-party risks and building a culture of responsible AI use.


“The traditional cybersecurity playbook still is absolutely relevant, but it has to be a lot leaner and a lot faster,” Rivera said. “What you’re dealing with is changing constantly at a rapid pace we’ve never seen before.”


Rivera compared effective cybersecurity to Formula 1 racing: The goal is not to put the brakes on the business, but to build in the right protections so it can move forward quickly and securely.
